resources.string: Watches Instagram only. When you land on Reels or Explore, it backs you out and shows a reminder. No data leaves your phone.
Enabled in settings but NOT running — toggle it off and on in Accessibility Settings, or reboot
Android 13+: if the accessibility toggle is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"), go to Settings > Apps > Reels Blocker > tap the ⋮ menu > \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Hide the Explore grid (searching for accounts still works)
Explore hidden. Tap the search bar above to find accounts.
Allow reels friends send in DMs (only the one you tap; swiping on gets blocked)
One UI kills background services aggressively. Tap below and allow \"unrestricted\" battery. Also check Settings > Apps > Reels Blocker > Battery > Unrestricted.
Debug: log Instagram screen IDs to Logcat
